sourceFile: 83. BRS-201506 Report Test sample SM ass'y Offset date 27.8.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the SM offset validation context but misgroups baseline/test rows and includes unreliable auto-extracted outcomes.
issues: Changed factor is overloaded with dates, classes, totals, and SUB2 instead of clear SM offset sample vs normal condition.
Function comparison uses one Normal row versus Total Test; source conclusion supports Total Test versus Total Normal.
Subgroup key Class 1 is unsupported as primary grouping for the whole case.
Measurement outcomes cite headers only and contain nonsensical stats from table extraction.
SM offset SUB2 rows are treated as comparable conditions without clear baseline/test meaning.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the main comparison be Total Test SM offset sample vs Total Normal for function NG rate?
Are SUB2 SM offset NG rows process-monitoring context or part of the baseline/test comparison?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to SM offset sample/YK+SM offset test versus normal production condition.
Use row 36 Total Test and row 37 Total Normal for function NG comparison, with row 42 as conclusion support.
Keep yoke class 1~3 and SUB2 as subgroup/context only unless rows prove they are changed factors.
Remove or rebuild header-only measurement outcomes using actual data rows and conclusions.
Separate non-comparable process monitoring metrics or mark them contextual/not judged.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but key citations are misgrouped and header-only evidence is insufficient.
